correctness.rationale: Exact polar vertex inequalities, split positive and negative coordinate parts, norm bound t²+2(1+t²)μ≤1+4μ and feasible endpoint maximizers give equality and all tangencies. The compact fractional polytope yields finite maximizers. Probabilistic graph sequence has o(N) triangles and o(N) independence, proving unbounded strict gap. The embedded 35-vertex graph6 witness has independently enumerated independence number 8. Finite checks do not establish the universal assertion.

value.rationale: Exact Euclidean inradius and complete centered contact-facet characterization for every graph Hansen polytope is a natural structural theorem. The finite Ramsey witness and unbounded asymptotic discrepancy show an essential, arbitrarily large breakdown of the perfect-graph clique law. Graph fractional geometry bridges metric convexity and the integrality gap of clique relaxations; not merely a relabeling, parameter slice, or finite table.
